title: Nonnegativity of the Radon–Nikodym density
statement:
Let $\mu$ and $
u$ be probability measures on a measurable space $\Omega$. Then at every point $x \in \Omega$, the real-valued Radon–Nikodym density $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x)$ satisfies $ rac{d\mu}{d
u}(x) \ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: μ, ν probability measures on a measurable space Ω
x is a point of Ω
